## Notes

Runtime is maintainer-run via `just zephyr verify-fvp-runtime` — hence `cadence = "manual"`, which is what exempts this row from the Runtime-cell requirement. The model is NOT licence-gated (that claim stood here until 2026-09-06 and was wrong): `nros setup --tool arm-fvp` fetches it from a pinned Arm CDN permalink, and the board-import fixture was verified booting on it (`nros: smoke ok`) the same day. What still keeps CI out is cost and x86_64-only hosting, not permission. Kept in-tree: it is the ASI reference consumer's target (phase-292), a real downstream user the CI evidence cannot see. phase-337 W9.a folded the `nros-board-fvp-aemv8r-smp` CRATE into `nros-board-zephyr/boards/fvp-aemv8r-smp/` — the crate's Rust half (a `Config` and a `run` loop) had zero consumers, so what it actually shipped was a prj.conf, a DTS overlay and a board.cmake: a config bundle wearing a Cargo.toml. Third row for this crate, which is exactly what W1.c's (crate, matrix_platform) keying is for.

See [Board Support Levels](../board-support-levels.md) for what each status means.
